maintenance_led.reason: Lawson MRO supplies and Test Equity/Techni-Tool support existing operations; Gexpro OEM C-parts supply is the other large part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial, commercial and OEM manufacturers; government is only a small part of Lawson's customers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Formed by combining Lawson, Gexpro and TestEquity, then adding bolt-ons like Partsmaster, Bolt Supply House and Kent Automotive.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly distributing MRO supplies, C-parts and test equipment that rivals also sell; Gexpro's vendor-managed inventory adds some stickiness.

notes: The maintenance answer is uncertain because the OEM supply business (Gexpro) is about as large as the MRO business.
